connector.name: Astral MCP
connector.registryDescription: Precision-audited astrology MCP: natal charts, transits, synastry, moon phases. No API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package astral-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport to run. Defaults to stdio. Set to http to expose a streamable HTTP endpoint instead.

env.name: ASTRAL_MCP_HOST
env.description: Host to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: ASTRAL_MCP_PORT
env.description: Port to bind when ASTRAL_MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

env.name: ASTRAL_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGIN
env.description: Allowed CORS origin for the HTTP transport. Defaults to the bound host:port.
